review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-17 against the pinned source and on-chain state: Frankencoin has no owner; minting runs through minter plugins and their registered positions. Anyone can propose a minter via suggestMinter (MIN_FEE 1000 ZCHF; on-chain MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD 1209600 seconds = 14 days at block 25551030), and qualified pool-share holders (at least 2% of holding-period-weighted votes, enforced by the deployed Equity.checkQualified) can veto during the application period via denyMinter. The deployed token contract has no proxy, and its own NatSpec states that the contract is not upgradable, so mint logic cannot change; the governed surface is limited to accepting or vetoing new minting plugins. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable code and a 14-day broad-holder veto govern new minters, issuance is on-chain collateralized, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced. Validation 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26096162: reserve() resolves to 0x1ba26788dfde592fec8bcb0eaff472a42be341b2; its runtime bytecode exactly matches the Blockscout verified Equity source, which defines private QUORUM = 200 basis points and rejects only votes below that threshold. The private constant has no QUORUM() getter. Current governance documentation describes a 1% shared quorum, but does not override this deployed legacy contract's 2% rule.
